value.signature: fn read (v : & Value , _c : & mut Context < '_ >) -> Result < Self , Error >

exception.justification: Justified: Private structural conversion inherits the complete public codec boundary; recording each nested field again would duplicate the same public disclosure.

review.body: { let mut fields = array_fields (v) ? ; let Some (Value :: Unsigned (tag)) = fields . next () else { return Err (Error :: Shape) ; } ; let result = match tag { 0 => Self :: Constant , 1 => Self :: Coordinate , 2 => Self :: Parameter , 3 => Self :: Negate , 4 => Self :: Sum , 5 => Self :: Difference , 6 => Self :: Product , 7 => Self :: Quotient , 8 => Self :: Exponential , 9 => Self :: Logarithm , 10 => Self :: Sigmoid , 11 => Self :: Tanh , 12 => Self :: Power , 13 => Self :: Root , 14 => Self :: ClampConstant , 15 => Self :: ClampResponsive , 16 => Self :: ClampJoin , _ => return Err (Error :: Shape) , } ; finish (fields) ? ; Ok (result) }
review.item_premise: Explicit structural mapping preserves the listed public fields and refuses unsupported shape or bounded arithmetic. It never grants admission; the enclosing codec records the complete input and result.
